name: 个股吧帖子流
description: 按股票代码打开个股吧列表页，返回指定条数（默认 30，最多 100）。无需登录。

inputs.name: code
inputs.description: 6 位股票代码（如 600519）；或用 params.url 传含代码的链接

inputs.name: maxPages
inputs.description: 最多翻页数（默认 3，上限 5；仅当结果不足 limit 时才翻页）

body.name: open_tab
body.note: 打开个股吧列表页（默认按时间）

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const code=(want('$code')||(want('$url').match(/(\d{6})/)||[])[1]||'');if(!code)return {ok:false,error:'no-code',hint:'请传 6 位股票代码（params.code）'};const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||30,100));const maxP=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$maxPages'))||3,5));const extract=(root)=>{const seen=new Set();return [...root.querySelectorAll('.listitem, tr[class*=listitem], [id*=tr_]')].map(r=>{const a=r.querySelector('a[href*=news],a[href*=caifuhao],a[href]');const nums=(r.innerText||'').match(/[\d.]+\s*[万]?/g)||[];const timeM=(r.textContent||'').match(/\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}/);return a?{title:(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,100),url:a.href.startsWith('//')?'https:'+a.href:a.href,reads:nums[0]||null,replies:nums[1]||null,time:timeM?timeM[0]:null}:null;}).filter(x=>x&&x.url&&!seen.has(x.url)&&seen.add(x.url));};await sleep(800);let posts=[];const start=Date.now();while(Date.now()-start<12000){posts=extract(document);if(posts.length>=3)break;await sleep(500);}let pages=1;while(posts.length<lim&&pages<maxP){const next='https://guba.eastmoney.com/list,'+code+'_'+(pages+1)+'.html';await sleep(1400+Math.floor(Math.random()*700));let html=null;try{const r=await fetch(next,{credentials:'include'});if(!r.ok)break;html=await r.text();}catch{break;}if(!html||html.length<500)break;let doc=null;try{doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');}catch{break;}const seen=new Set(posts.map(x=>x.url));const added=extract(doc);let grew=0;for(const it of added){if(posts.length>=lim)break;if(!seen.has(it.url)){posts.push(it);grew++;}}pages++;if(!grew)break;}return {ok:true,code:code,count:posts.length,posts:posts.slice(0,lim),pages:pages,sort:'time'};})()

body.note: 列表行解析：标题/链接/阅读/评论/时间
